fusions.name: Cornered Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes a mesh through a cone 3 tiles long at the cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 8 damage to everything caught in it. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of your health you are missing (max 50%).

fusions.name: Ribcracker
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in a conjured mesh and squeezes, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder In
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and draws up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fat of the Run
fusions.desc: Every kill hangs a catch on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per catch (25% at full). Unfed, a catch fades every 10 seconds.
